app.name: LinkShift
step.rollback: Rolling back: restoring the original state
step.move-back: Moving data back to the original drive
ui.page.transfer.title: Move a folder
ui.page.transfer.subtitle: Safe transaction: space → .bak → robocopy → mklink → verify → cleanup. Any error rolls everything back.
ui.page.scanner.title: C: drive scanner
ui.page.scanner.subtitle: Browser, messenger and shader caches plus heavy AppData folders. Folders that are already links (ReparsePoint) are excluded automatically.
ui.page.history.title: Link history
ui.page.history.subtitle: Entries from links_history.json. "Revert" removes the link and moves the files back to the original drive.
ui.transfer.target: Target directory (where to move, another drive)
ui.transfer.target.hint: The directory is created if missing. The source folder name is kept and a link appears in its place.
ui.transfer.junction.hint: Works without administrator rights. Recommended for folders on local drives.
ui.transfer.symlink.hint: Requires administrator rights. A true symbolic link (for apps that dislike junctions).
ui.transfer.noAdminHint: No administrator rights: the symlink will fall back to a junction and NTFS permissions will be copied partially (robocopy /COPY:DAT).
ui.transfer.dropHint: Tip: drag a folder into the app window and the path will be filled automatically.
ui.scanner.empty: Nothing heavier than the threshold was found — the drive is clean.
ui.scanner.confirmBulkText:
Move {count} folders to "{target}" and create links?

Folders locked by running programs will fail safely — no data will be harmed.
ui.page.links.title: Links on disk
ui.page.links.subtitle: Every junction and symlink under the selected folder — including ones created manually with mklink outside the app. "Revert" removes the link and moves the files back from the target drive.
ui.links.empty: No links found — everything is in place.
ui.links.hint: Windows system links (compatibility junctions like "Application Data") are hidden by default and flagged — removing them is not recommended. The C:\Windows tree is not scanned.
ui.links.confirmRevertText: The link "{path}" → "{target}" will be removed and the files will be moved back from the target drive to their original place. Continue?
ui.links.confirmUnlinkText: The target of the link "{path}" was not found — the files cannot be moved back. Only the link itself will be removed. Continue?
ui.history.empty: History is empty — no links have been created yet.
ui.history.revertConfirmText: The link "{path}" will be removed (rmdir) and the files will be moved back from the target drive. Continue?
ui.history.deleteConfirmText: Only the history entry about "{path}" will be removed. The link itself keeps working.
ui.status.notWindows: This app is designed for Windows: PowerShell, robocopy and mklink are required.
ERR_SOURCE_IS_LINK: The folder is already a link ({linkType}); moving it again is not required: {path}
ERR_SOURCE_IS_ROOT: Refusing to move a drive root: {path}
ERR_SYSTEM_PATH_FORBIDDEN: Windows system folders and Program Files must not be moved: {path}
ERR_TARGET_INSIDE_SOURCE: The target directory is inside the source folder: {path}
ERR_TARGET_EXISTS: A folder with the same name already exists in the target directory: {path}
ERR_NO_FREE_SPACE: Not enough space on drive {drive}: need {need}, available {free}
ERR_SOURCE_LOCKED: The folder is locked by a running program; copying never started. Close the apps using it: {path}
ERR_SOURCE_ACCESS_DENIED: Access to the folder is denied: {path}
ERR_RENAME_FAILED: Failed to rename the source folder: {details}
ERR_ROBOCOPY_FAILED: robocopy failed (exit code {exitCode}). Data was restored from .bak{hint}
ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED: ROLLBACK FAILED, data remains in .bak. Nothing was deleted: {details}
ERR_LINK_TARGET_MISSING: The link target is not accessible: {path}
ERR_REVERT_STATE_UNEXPECTED: Unexpected folder state; the revert was stopped for safety: {details}
ERR_REVERT_MOVE_FAILED: The revert was interrupted (exit code {exitCode}). Files remain in the target folder{hint}
WARN_SOURCE_CONTAINS_LINKS: {count} link(s) found inside the source folder; they were not copied (robocopy /XJ) and will remain in .bak
WARN_COPY_ACL_SKIPPED: No administrator rights: NTFS permissions were not fully copied (/COPY:DAT was used)
WARN_SYMLINK_FALLBACK: No administrator rights: a junction (mklink /J) was created instead of a symlink
WARN_BAK_KEPT: Could not delete .bak (some files are locked). Data is duplicated at: {path}
WARN_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY: The target folder is not empty and was left untouched: {path}
reason.process_running: The application is running: {process}.exe — close it before moving
reason.temp_hint: Temp folder: cleaning it is safer than moving it
reason.verify_manually: Can be moved, but check what this folder belongs to
